buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at

the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. In addition, forward any special storage/handling instructions. 2. The supplier shall physically identify the shelf life expiration date on the deliverable product or the unit packaging. 3. At the time of supply, the remaining life of items should be at least 75% of its total life. 4. Date of Manufacturing and Date of Expiry should be indicated on each container. 5. Test reports, Data Sheets and OEM Certificate of Conformance (CoC) and supplier CoC to be provided al ong with the supplies. .
